heading: INT. MERCY GENERAL - NIGHT SHIFT NURSES' STATION - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MERCY GENERAL - NIGHT SHIFT NURSES' STATION - NIGHT
Open-plan.
Too many monitors.
A drooping fern and a laminated sign: PLEASE DON'T MICROWAVE FISH.
KOFI (30s, scrubs, headset) taps at a laptop with a video call open.

TARA (20s, lanyard bursting with pins) wheels over on a stool and PIP (intern, 22) hovers behind her with a clipboard held like a shield, while a janitor mops slowly in the background and a drip pole in the corner, for no reason, slowly rotates by itself.
On Kofi's screen: a Slack channel, #night-shift-chaos.
ON SCREEN: ORRIN: has anyone seen the thing in room 6
ON SCREEN: ORRIN: the glowing thing
Orrin's on his break and he's already losing it.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Orrin's always losing it. Last week he said the fridge was talking.
units.name: TARA

units.text: The fridge was talking. That was the fridge's night-shift voice.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: On the laptop, DR. NAKAMURA's face fills a Zoom window, pixelated, ceiling fan behind him.
Team, can you hear me? Admissions says there's a patient in six who isn't on the board.
units.name: DR. NAKAMURA

units.text: Is that bad?
units.name: PIP

units.text: It's a patient who isn't on the board.
units.name: DR. NAKAMURA

units.text: So, yes.
units.name: TARA

units.text: THE WOMAN (60s, nightgown, barefoot, faintly luminous) steps out of the corridor and stands at the end of the desk, perfectly calm.
Ma'am? Are you looking for someone?
units.name: PIP

units.text: Good evening. I'm told this is where the others wait.
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: Kofi shuts the laptop lid, hard.
Dr. Nakamura's voice is cut off mid-word.
Others?
units.name: KOFI

units.text: My name is Elspeth. I was admitted four hundred years ago. Is there still a form?
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: Silence.
The mop stops.
The drip pole stops.
ON SCREEN (Kofi's phone, face up): ORRIN: told u
Kofi, get the clipboard.
units.name: TARA

units.text: ELSPETH smiles, patient, and holds out her hand.
